subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'pattern'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the concerned line is the definition of the figure of speech 'rhyme scheme' as it is the rhythmic pattern of sounds that is repeated at the end of a line or stanza of a poem.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word is 'pattern'. 
 
• 'Pattern' means 'a particular way in which something is done, is organized or happens.'
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

​

Correct Sentence:__ * Rhyme scheme is the __**pattern**__ that is created at the end of the lines of poetry.*
